article.title: 365 Days of Fortune Books: 12 Titles from 3000 Studios Press (2026 Guide)
article.author: Jeremy Swain
article.summary: Every 365 days of fortune title from 3000 Studios Press in one place: 12 original books by Jeremy Swain, $9.99 each as EPUB and PDF.
article.leadParagraph: Looking for 365 days of fortune books? 3000 Studios Press publishes 12 original 365 days of fortune titles written by Jeremy Swain. A daily guide for every sign of 2026. This guide lists every one, explains what each shelf offers, and shows exactly where to buy them.

sections.heading: The full 365 Days of Fortune shelf
body: The shelf includes “365 Days of Fortune: Aquarius 2026”, “365 Days of Fortune: Capricorn 2026”, “365 Days of Fortune: Sagittarius 2026”, “365 Days of Fortune: Scorpio 2026”, “365 Days of Fortune: Libra 2026” and “365 Days of Fortune: Virgo 2026”.

It also includes “365 Days of Fortune: Leo 2026”, “365 Days of Fortune: Cancer 2026”, “365 Days of Fortune: Gemini 2026”, “365 Days of Fortune: Taurus 2026”, “365 Days of Fortune: Aries 2026” and “365 Days of Fortune: Pisces 2026”.

sections.heading: Price and formats
body: Every title on the shelf is $9.99. Each purchase includes both EPUB and PDF, delivered at checkout from the studio store on Payhip, so the same book works on an e-reader, a tablet, a phone or a printer.
Print editions of the wider 3000 Studios Press catalog are distributed through IngramSpark, which means bookstores and libraries can order copies through their usual channels.

sections.heading: Where to buy
body: Open the Books page at https://3000studios.vip/books and tap any cover to go straight to that title's checkout. The 365 Days of Fortune filter on that page shows only this shelf.
New releases and chapter previews land first in the free 3000 Studios Substack newsletter.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
body: How many 365 days of fortune books does 3000 Studios Press publish? 12, all listed above.
Who writes them? Every title is written by Jeremy Swain and published under the 3000 Studios Press imprint.
What do I get? A $9.99 purchase includes the EPUB and the PDF of the book.
